Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Putting the short matrix below and attaching a one-page options brief. Will follow up with a pricing workbook and a tailored commit example once we confirm your expected monthly token/throughput band.

Quick summary (high level):
- Uptime tiers: Standard (99.5%), Elevated (99.9%), Critical (99.95%).
- Response windows (typical):
  - Standard: Business-hours (M-F 9am-5pm local) initial triage within 4 hours; P1 escalation within 8 hours
  - Elevated: 24x7 monitoring+on-call; initial triage within 1 hour; P1 within 4 hours
  - Critical: 24x7 with dedicated escalation path and guaranteed 1-hour triage; SLA credits scale for breach.
- Flexible-hours model: add-on blocks of 50/200/500 on-call hours billed monthly; blocks provide guaranteed routing to a regional team during requested windows.
- On-call capacity: base SLA includes coverage for up to 2 simultaneous P1s; add-on sold for dedicated capacity (3-10 concurrent P1 scaling).

Pricing note: commits reduce the on-call surcharge and per-hour flex block rate; example attached. For VPC/private deployments there is a one-time onboarding + additional runbook integration fee (calls out encryption and audit logging requirements).

Attachments: SLA-options-20270527.pdf (PDF) — one-page matrix; Pricing-workbook-commit.xlsx (xlsx) — example workbook

Next step: can you confirm expected average monthly token volume and whether you want 24x7 or business-hours + 200 flex hours to start? I’ll run a commit-case and send a draft MA redline.
